name: Being Too Busy
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of being overly busy and burdened by worldly pursuits, urging believers to commit their ways to the Lord and trust in His provision rather than relying on their own wisdom. The Bible calls for a balance in life, recognizing that there is a proper season for every activity, and encourages believers to seek God's kingdom first, promising that all other needs will be met. In times of stress and labor, Jesus invites the weary to come to Him for rest, reminding us to be still and acknowledge God's sovereignty amid life's demands.
